title: Improve billing export schema for auditability (meter_version, aggregation_window, invoice_run_id)
author: Cole Summers
body:
## Summary
This PR improves the billing export schema to make invoice totals explainable from raw telemetry with fewer side channels. Specifically, it adds three explicit fields to every exported row: (1) meter_version (string) — the canonical version of the meter definitions used to compute the row, (2) aggregation_window (string) — the inclusive time window used for aggregation, and (3) invoice_run_id (string/uuid) — a stable identifier for the invoice generation run that produced the export.

## Motivation
Finance/Billing Controls needs audit-ready evidence during close and for dispute investigations. Today we can reconcile amounts, but the export itself doesn’t carry enough provenance to answer: “Which meter logic produced this line item?”, “What exact window was included?”, and “Which invoice job produced the output?” without joining logs and job metadata.

This change is intended to support the meter reconciliation program (ENG-4821) and the targeted backfill + audit workflow (ENG-4826).

## What changed
- Export schema (billing_export_v1):
  - Added `meter_version` (non-null for new exports)
  - Added `aggregation_window` (ISO-8601 range string; e.g., `2026-02-01T00:00:00Z/2026-03-01T00:00:00Z`)
  - Added `invoice_run_id` (uuid; required for invoice-triggered exports)
- Invoice generator:
  - Generates `invoice_run_id` once per run and propagates it through the aggregator/exporter boundary.
- Metering pipeline:
  - Threads `meter_version` from meter definitions at aggregation time, rather than re-deriving later.
- Data contracts / downstream:
  - Updated BigQuery table schema + parquet writer schema.
  - Updated internal docs / examples used by Finance (no changes to pricing or amounts).

## Compatibility / rollout
- Backwards compatible: existing consumers reading the export should continue to work as long as they don’t assume an exact column set.
- Historical exports will not be rewritten by this PR; the new fields will be `NULL` for old partitions unless/until we backfill.
- For safety, `invoice_run_id` is enforced as required when `export_reason = INVOICE_RUN`. It may be null for ad-hoc exports triggered by engineering tools (explicitly marked as such).

## Testing
- Unit tests for schema versioning and non-null requirements.
- Integration test: end-to-end invoice run creates export rows with consistent `invoice_run_id` across line items and with the expected `aggregation_window` string.
- Manual: ran a staging invoice run and verified the export matched the invoice totals and that the new provenance fields were present.

## Follow-ups
- Wire `invoice_run_id` into the daily reconciliation output (ENG-4821) so Finance can reference the exact run in evidence packets.
- Decide whether we want to backfill the last 2 closed months with the new fields as part of the audit window (ENG-4826).

---

### Commit summary
1) billing/export: add provenance fields to schema + writer
2) billing/invoice: generate and propagate invoice_run_id
3) metering/agg: thread meter_version + window info
4) tests: add schema + e2e invoice export assertions
5) docs: update export contract examples

### Changed areas / files (high level)
- services/billing-exporter/*
- services/invoice-runner/*
- services/meter-aggregator/*
- packages/data-contracts/billing_export.schema.json
- packages/data-contracts/billing_export.bq.sql
- tests/integration/billing_export_provenance_test.ts

### Illustrative snippet
Exporter row now includes:
- meter_version: `v3.1.0`
- aggregation_window: `2026-02-01T00:00:00Z/2026-03-01T00:00:00Z`
- invoice_run_id: `7f2b1b2e-4b7d-4b4e-b4d2-8c7e55b8e2a1`

---

## Review conversation (condensed)

**Nadia Rahman:** Can we guarantee `meter_version` comes from the same definitions snapshot as the aggregation logic? I don’t want the exporter reading “latest” at export time.

**Cole Summers (author):** Yep — it’s captured at aggregation time and stored on the billing-ready aggregate rows, then copied through to export. Exporter never consults meter defs.

**Logan Wright:** For `aggregation_window`, can we standardize the format? Please avoid separate start/end columns unless we’re sure downstream can handle it.

**Cole:** Kept it as a single ISO-8601 interval string (start/end). Also added a helper so all writers produce identical formatting.

**Emily Stone:** Finance needs to reference this in close evidence. Can `invoice_run_id` be required for invoice runs? If it’s sometimes null, we’ll keep chasing down job logs.

**Cole:** Added a guard: when `export_reason == INVOICE_RUN`, `invoice_run_id` must be present or the run fails before writing exports. For ad-hoc exports, it’s allowed to be null but is explicitly labeled `export_reason == ADHOC`.

**Allison Grant:** Please emit a metric when the non-null guard trips so we can alert.

**Cole:** Added `billing_export_invalid_provenance_total{reason=...}` and logs with the run id when available.

**Nadia:** One request: add a regression test to ensure invoice_run_id is consistent across all rows for a single run.

**Cole:** Added in integration test (assert same UUID across all rows with same invoice_id).

Approvals: Nadia Rahman ✅, Logan Wright ✅, Emily Stone ✅, Allison Grant ✅
